subject: ClearCard expansion — endorsement and measurable outcomes
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@clearcard.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: ClearCard expansion — endorsement and measurable outcomes

Hi Elena,

Hope you had a great week. ClearCard's usage of Redwood has been a fantastic example for other fintech teams — your engineering team’s steady throughput during peak payroll windows has been impressive to watch. As part of the upcoming renewal/expansion bundle we're preparing, would ClearCard be willing to provide a short customer endorsement we can include in a one-page case snippet?

What would help most: 1–2 sentences on business impact (cost savings or latency improvements), and a quick note on who we can attribute the quote to (title + permission to use ClearCard logo). I attached a brief reference-template you can edit if helpful.

If it's easier, a one-paragraph reply on this thread is perfect. We’re aiming to include this in the renewal packet for the execs next Wednesday (Jan 21).

Thanks so much — I appreciate your partnership.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: reference-template.docx
From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@clearcard.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-01-10T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ClearCard expansion — endorsement and measurable outcomes

Hi Aditya,

Happy to help — we can do a short endorsement. I need to run the quote by Tom (Head of Ops) for logo use, but a sentence or two on the impact is straightforward.

Quick question: can you share the exact metrics you plan to call out? Our legal team prefers numbers tied to specific time windows.

Elena
VP of Platform Engineering | ClearCard
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-01-11T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearCard expansion — endorsement and measurable outcomes

Monica / Karthik — looping you both in. Elena asked for the exact metrics tied to a time window. Can we pull a 90-day before/after snapshot for their production payment flows showing: average p99 latency reduction, and cost per 1M tokens?

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/CLRD-EXP-2026-07
Drive draft for case snippet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearCardCaseStudyDraft

Timeline: Elena needs a firm quote for legal by EOD Jan 15 so they can get Tom’s approval. Can you take point on the numbers and a short 2-line paragraph we can offer as sample language?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Elena once you have the snippet.

-Aditya
From: Elena Varga <elena.varga@clearcard.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@clearcard.com>
Date: 2026-01-15T14:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: ClearCard expansion — endorsement and measurable outcomes

Aditya —

Apologies for the short delay. Tom approved the logo use and legal okayed the following language tied to our observed production window (Oct 1–Dec 31, 2025). You have permission to use our logo and the quote below in Redwood marketing materials and renewal collateral.

Quote (Elena Varga, VP of Platform Engineering):
“Partnering with Redwood Inference reduced our inference cost-per-1M tokens by 42% while improving tail latency for live payment validation by 27%, enabling us to process peak payroll volumes without incident.”

I’m attaching a screenshot of the Redwood usage dashboard and the CSV snapshot our ops team generated. The ops team has redacted internal IDs.

Also — please attribute the quote to: Elena Varga, VP of Platform Engineering, ClearCard.

Regards,
Elena
attachments: ClearCard-endorsement-screenshot.png; clearcard-usage-dashboard-jan2026.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Varga <elena.varga@clearcard.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-01-16T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ClearCard expansion — endorsement and measurable outcomes

Elena — thank you, this is excellent and exactly what we need. Appreciate Tom and your team moving quickly.

Next steps on our side: Monica will draft the one-page case snippet and a pull-quote image using the logo; Karthik will prepare a short technical blurb for the appendix showing the before/after latency and cost methodology. We’ll share both for a quick legal sign-off — we’ll use the DocuSign link below for a logo release if you prefer an e-sig.

DocuSign (logo release): https://www.docusign.com/link/clearcard-logo-release
Draft for review (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearCardCaseStudyDraft

If that timeline works, we’ll aim to finalize the packet by Jan 21 for the renewal committee. Thanks again.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
